note: These are source-listed reference patterns, not evidence of a specific farmer's existing practice, local adoption, or recommendation. The example schedules below are dated demonstrations of the constraints, not locally validated calendars. Keep a farmer-entered schedule separate as the actual baseline.

example_schedules.name: Reference example · Boro → fallow → transplanted Aman
example_schedules.assumption_note: Dates are illustrative dates inside cited BRRI windows; this is not a farmer-reported rotation.

example_schedules.name: Candidate · Mustard → Boro → transplanted Aman
example_schedules.assumption_note: Mustard-to-Boro interval is only 85 days to Boro transplant, within BAMIS mustard's 80–100 day duration range; possible same-field overlap needs actual harvest confirmation.

example_schedules.name: Candidate · Fallow → fallow → transplanted Aman
example_schedules.assumption_note: The BRRI profile lists the pattern. Fallow is not treated as a crop or as proof of a farmer's actual practice.

example_schedules.name: Rejected example · Mustard overlaps Boro field entry
example_schedules.assumption_note: Boro enters the field 66 days after mustard sowing, earlier than even the 80-day minimum sourced duration. Same-field sequence is infeasible under these dates.
